newsitem.title: USA: Mid Am to redeem all shrs cum/convert stock.
newsitem.headline: Mid Am to redeem all shrs cum/convert stock.

text.p: Mid Am Inc said Thursday that it will redeem all 944,373 outstanding shares of its $1.8125 cumulative convertible preferred stock, Series A on June 26. The total redemption price is $25.13 per share.
The company said shareholders also have the right to convert the preferred shares into common stock prior to June 16, at a rate of 2.44015 shares of common stock for each share of preferred stock.
Based upon the closing price of the company's common stock on April 30, said the company, the conversion rate corresponds to a conversion price of $42.09 per share.
Mid Am is a $2.2 billion financial services holding company based in Bowling Green, Ohio.
